findings.explanation: The local opaque call returns do not themselves track the internal acquisitions at these latest-result call sites. The listing has a category-derived directory probe and a conditional acquisition of entry names. The load has a selected-path probe, a conditional UTF-8 acquisition and a separate parse outcome. The parsed return and the internal file text have different visibility and provenance.

The report row member value demands likewise do not explicitly preserve row and value-list structure and cardinality.
